blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 PIC/S PE 011-1 官方術語定義，確保在合約、SOP 和稽核溝通中使用一致的語言
blocks.en: Master the official PIC/S PE 011-1 term definitions so that contracts, SOPs and audit communications use consistent language

blocks.zh: 理解供應鏈角色術語（Contract Giver、Contract Acceptor、Wholesale Distributor）的精確定義與責任邊界
blocks.en: Understand the precise definitions and responsibility boundaries of the supply chain role terms (Contract Giver, Contract Acceptor, Wholesale Distributor)

blocks.zh: 區分 Qualification 與 Validation 在 GDP 語境下的定義差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the GDP definitions of Qualification and Validation

blocks.zh: 掌握「假藥」(Falsified Medicinal Product) 的正式定義，以及 EEA（歐洲經濟區）內外定義的細微差異
blocks.en: Master the formal definition of "Falsified Medicinal Product" and the subtle differences between the definitions inside and outside the EEA (European Economic Area)

blocks.zh: 了解溫度術語（深凍、冷藏、冷涼、室溫、環境溫度）的精確數值範圍
blocks.en: Know the exact numerical ranges for the temperature terms (deep frozen, refrigerator, cold or cool, room temperature, ambient)

blocks.zh: 應用詞彙表作為 CDMO 標準 SOP 和合約起草的術語基準
blocks.en: Use the glossary as the terminology baseline for CDMO standard SOPs and contract drafting

blocks.zh: Group 1: Supply Chain Roles — 供應鏈角色定義
blocks.en: Group 1: Supply Chain Roles

blocks.zh: 原文定義 Official Definitions
blocks.en: Official Definitions

blocks.zh: 供應鏈角色 / Supply Chain Roles
blocks.en: Supply Chain Roles

blocks.zh: 供應鏈活動動詞 / Supply Chain Activity Verbs
blocks.en: Supply Chain Activity Verbs

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：供應鏈角色的精確定義
blocks.en: Core Concept: Precise Definitions of Supply Chain Roles

blocks.zh: Wholesale Distribution 的邊界： 這個定義包含五個動詞（procuring 採購、holding 持有、supplying 供應、importing 進口、exporting 出口），但明確排除「直接對公眾供應」。這個邊界決定了你是否需要持有批發配送許可。
blocks.en: The boundary of Wholesale Distribution: The definition contains five verbs (procuring, holding, supplying, importing, exporting) but explicitly excludes "supplying to the public". This boundary determines whether you need to hold a wholesale distribution authorisation.

blocks.zh: Contract Giver vs. Contract Acceptor 的法律主體： 注意定義說「company」（法人主體），個人不構成 GDP 意義上的 Contract Giver 或 Acceptor。這在合約起草時很重要 — 合約必須在兩個法人之間簽訂，不是個人之間。
blocks.en: The legal entity behind Contract Giver vs. Contract Acceptor: Note that the definition says "company" (a legal entity); an individual cannot be a Contract Giver or Acceptor in the GDP sense. This matters when drafting contracts: the contract must be signed between two legal entities, not between individuals.

blocks.zh: Transport vs. Holding 的關鍵區分： 運輸定義中有一個微妙的限定語：「without storing them for unjustified periods of time」。這意味著，如果中途在運輸樞紐的暫存時間「不合理地長」，可能從「運輸」轉變為「持有（倉儲）」，觸發更嚴格的倉儲要求。這在跨境運輸清關延誤時尤其重要。
blocks.en: The key distinction between Transport and Holding: The definition of transportation contains a subtle qualifier: "without storing them for unjustified periods of time". This means that if goods are held at a transport hub for an "unjustifiably long" period, the activity may shift from "transportation" to "holding (storage)" and trigger the stricter storage requirements. This is especially important when customs clearance delays occur on cross-border shipments.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 「Supplying」（供應批發商到藥局）和「supplying medicinal products to the public」（藥局到病人）雖然動作相似，但 GDP 只管前者。這就像批發市場（賣給零售商）和便利商店（賣給消費者）的差異：食品批發商適用批發法規，便利商店適用零售法規。Wholesale Distribution 是藥品供應鏈的「批發端」管控機制。
blocks.en: "Supplying" (wholesaler to pharmacy) and "supplying medicinal products to the public" (pharmacy to patient) look similar, but GDP governs only the former. It is like the difference between a wholesale market (selling to retailers) and a convenience store (selling to consumers): food wholesalers fall under wholesale regulations, while convenience stores fall under retail regulations. Wholesale Distribution is the control mechanism for the "wholesale end" of the medicinal product supply chain.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: Competent Authority 在台灣的對應： 台灣的 Competent Authority 是衛生福利部食品藥物管理署 (TFDA)。當 PE 011-1 提及「competent authority」的要求或許可時，在台灣語境下即指 TFDA 的相關規定。了解這個對應關係，有助於將 GDP 要求準確轉化為台灣法規合規義務。
blocks.en: The Taiwan counterpart of Competent Authority: The Competent Authority in Taiwan is the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) under the Ministry of Health and Welfare. When PE 011-1 refers to requirements or authorisations of the "competent authority", in the Taiwan context this means the relevant TFDA rules. Understanding this correspondence helps you translate GDP requirements accurately into Taiwan regulatory compliance obligations.

blocks.zh: Public Service Obligations 的實務意涵： 這個定義要求許可持有者確保「適當且持續的供應」以滿足病患需求。對 CDMO 而言，若你是某藥品的台灣唯一製造商，這個義務可能意味著你不能因商業考量隨意停產或縮減產量，否則可能違反 GDP 的公共服務義務。
blocks.en: Practical implications of Public Service Obligations: This definition requires the authorisation holder to ensure "adequate and continued supply" to meet patients' needs. For a CDMO that is the only manufacturer of a medicinal product in Taiwan, this obligation may mean you cannot stop or cut production at will for commercial reasons, or you may breach the GDP public service obligations.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 成品在出廠後，放在桃園機場冷藏倉等待清關，已等待 72 小時。這段時間算是「Transport」還是「Holding」？有什麼實務影響？
blocks.en: After release, your CDMO finished product sits in the cold storage warehouse at Taoyuan Airport awaiting customs clearance for 72 hours. Does this period count as "Transport" or "Holding"? What are the practical implications?

blocks.zh: 「Procuring」定義說是從「manufacturers, importers or other wholesale distributors」購買。若你直接向藥品原料商（API manufacturer）採購，這屬於 wholesale distribution 的 procuring 嗎？
blocks.en: The definition of "Procuring" says purchasing from "manufacturers, importers or other wholesale distributors". If you buy directly from an API manufacturer, does this count as procuring under wholesale distribution?

blocks.zh: Group 2: Regulatory & Licence Terms — 法規與許可術語
blocks.en: Group 2: Regulatory & Licence Terms

blocks.zh: 核心概念：假藥定義的雙軌制
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Dual-Track Definition of Falsified Medicinal Products

blocks.zh: PE 011-1 提供了兩個「假藥」定義，這反映了其全球適用性：
blocks.en: PE 011-1 provides two definitions of "falsified medicinal product", reflecting its global applicability:

blocks.zh: EEA 內（更嚴格、更廣泛）： 涵蓋身份、來源、歷史三個面向的虛假表示，且細化到成分、輔料、濃度、製造商、原產國、MAH（Marketing Authorisation Holder）、配送記錄等。這是歐盟 2011/62/EU 假藥指令的精髓。
blocks.en: Within the EEA (stricter and broader): It covers false representations in three aspects (identity, source and history), broken down into ingredients, excipients, strength, manufacturer, country of origin, MAH (Marketing Authorisation Holder), distribution records and so on. This is the essence of the EU Falsified Medicines Directive 2011/62/EU.

blocks.zh: EEA 外（WHO 定義，較簡潔）： 聚焦在「刻意且詐騙性地在身份和/或來源上貼假標籤」— 強調故意性（deliberately and fraudulently）。
blocks.en: Outside the EEA (WHO definition, more concise): It focuses on "deliberately and fraudulently mislabelled with respect to identity and/or source", emphasising intent (deliberately and fraudulently).

blocks.zh: 台灣的定位： 台灣不在 EEA 範圍內，理論上適用 WHO 定義。但在實際稽核和 SOP 撰寫中，建議以 EEA 的更嚴格三面向定義作為內部標準，因為它更全面，也與主要客戶（歐美藥廠）的合規要求一致。
blocks.en: Taiwan's position: Taiwan is outside the EEA, so in theory the WHO definition applies. In actual audits and SOP writing, however, we recommend using the stricter EEA three-aspect definition as the internal standard, because it is more comprehensive and consistent with the compliance requirements of major customers (European and US pharmaceutical companies).

blocks.zh: Due Diligence（盡職調查）的精神就像在借錢給朋友之前先「做功課」。在 GDP 的委外語境中，due diligence 就是 7.2.2 的供應商能力評估（稽核）— 你不能看對方一臉誠實就簽合約，必須調查對方的資質、設備、過往記錄，然後才決定是否委外以及如何設計管控。「Standard of care（特定注意義務標準）」則是在法律層面保護你：只要你執行了合理標準的盡職調查，即使出了問題，法律責任也有相應減輕的空間。
blocks.en: The spirit of Due Diligence is like doing your homework before lending money to a friend. In the GDP outsourcing context, due diligence is the supplier capability assessment (audit) in 7.2.2: you cannot sign a contract just because the other party looks honest. You must investigate their qualifications, facilities and track record, and only then decide whether and how to outsource and how to design the controls. The "Standard of care" protects you at the legal level: if you carried out due diligence to a reasonable standard, there is room to reduce your legal liability even when something goes wrong.

blocks.zh: Manufacturing Licence 包含配送授權： 定義括號中的「and distribute」非常重要 — 製造許可本身就包含了對該許可所涵蓋藥品的配送授權。這呼應了本指引 Introduction 的核心觀點：持有製造許可的廠商若自行配送，必須符合 GDP（因為製造許可已包含配送授權，所以配送活動在許可範疇內，GDP 義務隨之而來）。
blocks.en: A Manufacturing Licence includes the distribution authorisation: The words "and distribute" in the parentheses of the definition are very important: the manufacturing authorisation itself includes authorisation to distribute the medicinal products it covers. This echoes the core point of the Introduction to this guide: a manufacturer that holds a manufacturing authorisation and distributes its own products must comply with GDP (because the manufacturing authorisation already includes distribution, the distribution activities fall within the scope of the authorisation and GDP obligations follow).

blocks.zh: 自由貿易區 (Free Zone) 的實務意義： 定義說自由貿易區/保稅倉庫雖然「在海關領土內但與其他區域隔離」。對台灣 CDMO 而言，若客戶的倉庫位於加工出口區，產品進入後的保管和配送仍須符合 GDP，不能因為是「海關特殊區域」就認為不適用。
blocks.en: Practical significance of a Free Zone: The definition says a free zone/bonded warehouse is "part of the customs territory but separated from other parts". For a Taiwan CDMO, if a customer's warehouse is located in an export processing zone, storage and distribution of products after entry must still comply with GDP; you cannot assume GDP does not apply just because it is a "special customs area".

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 倉庫收到一批退回品，外觀完整但供應商無法提供完整的配送鏈文件（invoice、批次追蹤記錄均不齊全）。依據假藥定義：
blocks.en: Your CDMO warehouse receives a returned batch. The packaging looks intact, but the supplier cannot provide complete distribution chain documents (invoices and batch tracking records are both incomplete). Under the definition of falsified medicinal product:

blocks.zh: EEA 定義中的「歷史面向（history）」包含「records and documents relating to the distribution channels used」— 缺少配送文件本身就可能構成「假藥」的特徵之一
blocks.en: The "history" aspect of the EEA definition includes "records and documents relating to the distribution channels used", so missing distribution documents may themselves be one of the features of a "falsified medicinal product"

blocks.zh: 依 GDP，這批產品應立即隔離並標示為「Suspected Falsified」，通知主管機關，不得放行
blocks.en: Under GDP, this batch should be quarantined immediately and labelled "Suspected Falsified", the competent authority notified, and the batch must not be released

blocks.zh: 這個情境說明為何 GDP 要求完整的 chain of custody 文件 — 文件的缺失本身就是風險信號
blocks.en: This scenario shows why GDP requires complete chain of custody documents: the absence of documents is itself a risk signal

blocks.zh: 一批藥品的成分完全正確，但製造商標示是偽造的（產品實際由未授權工廠製造）。依 EEA 假藥定義的哪個面向認定為假藥？
blocks.en: A batch of medicinal products has entirely correct ingredients, but the manufacturer labelling is forged (the product was actually made by an unauthorised factory). Under which aspect of the EEA definition is it identified as falsified?

blocks.zh: 若你在 SOP 中引用「假藥」的定義，你會選擇 EEA 版本還是 WHO 版本，或兩者都引用？理由為何？
blocks.en: If you cite the definition of "falsified medicinal product" in an SOP, would you choose the EEA version, the WHO version, or both? Why?

blocks.zh: Group 3: Quality System Terms — 品質系統術語
blocks.en: Group 3: Quality System Terms

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 在品質保證體系中的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Position of GDP within the Quality Assurance System

blocks.zh: GDP 是 QA 的一部分： 定義明確指出 GDP 是「品質保證 (quality assurance) 的一部分」，涵蓋從製造廠到藥局/授權人員的整個供應鏈。這個定義確立了 GDP 的邊界：
blocks.en: GDP is part of QA: The definition states clearly that GDP is "that part of quality assurance", covering the whole supply chain from the manufacturer to the pharmacy/person authorised to supply to the public. This definition establishes the boundaries of GDP:

blocks.zh: 起點： Site of manufacturer（製造廠的放行點）
blocks.en: Starting point: Site of manufacturer (the manufacturer's release point)

blocks.zh: 終點： 藥局或授權對公眾供應的人員
blocks.en: End point: The pharmacy or the person authorised to supply to the public

blocks.zh: 中間全段： 所有批發配送活動
blocks.en: Everything in between: All wholesale distribution activities

blocks.zh: GMP 管製造過程，GDP 管製造後到零售前的整段流通，兩者合力保護藥品從原料到病人手中的完整性。
blocks.en: GMP governs the manufacturing process, while GDP governs the whole flow from after manufacture to before retail; together they protect the integrity of the medicinal product from raw material to the patient.

blocks.zh: Qualification vs. Validation 的精確區分：
blocks.en: The precise distinction between Qualification and Validation:

blocks.zh: Qualification： 僅針對「equipment（設備）」— 確認設備正確運作並達到預期結果
blocks.en: Qualification: Applies only to "equipment": confirming that the equipment works correctly and leads to the expected results

blocks.zh: Validation： 更廣泛，涵蓋「procedure（程序）、process（過程）、equipment（設備）、material（材料）、activity（活動）、system（系統）」
blocks.en: Validation: Broader, covering "procedure, process, equipment, material, activity and system"

blocks.zh: 在 GDP 語境中，保溫箱的「qualification」是確認設備本身；而整個包裝-配送-交付流程的「validation」則是確認整個系統在實際操作條件下都能達到目標。
blocks.en: In the GDP context, "qualification" of an insulated shipper confirms the equipment itself, while "validation" of the whole packing-distribution-delivery process confirms that the whole system achieves its objective under actual operating conditions.

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management（品質風險管理）的四個步驟（評估 Assessment、控制 Control、溝通 Communication、審查 Review）可以用「颱風應對」比喻：氣象局評估颱風路徑和強度（assessment）→ 政府決定是否停班停課、發放物資（control）→ 媒體廣播告知市民（communication）→ 颱風後評估防災措施是否有效（review）。QRM 就是把這個系統性思考應用到藥品品質風險上，讓每一個決策都有依據，而非憑直覺行事。
blocks.en: The four steps of Quality Risk Management (Assessment, Control, Communication, Review) can be explained with a "typhoon response" analogy: the weather bureau assesses the typhoon's path and intensity (assessment), the government decides whether to close offices and schools and distribute supplies (control), the media broadcast the information to citizens (communication), and after the typhoon the disaster prevention measures are evaluated for effectiveness (review). QRM applies this systematic thinking to medicinal product quality risks so that every decision has a basis rather than relying on intuition.

blocks.zh: Qualification 定義的簡潔與 GMP 的詳細定義： PE 011-1 的 Qualification 定義非常簡潔（只提到 equipment），相比之下，GMP 文件（如 PIC/S Annex 15）對 qualification 的定義更詳盡（DQ、IQ、OQ、PQ 各階段）。在實務中，GDP 的 qualification 概念應結合 GMP 的詳細方法論執行，而非只以這個簡短定義為準。這也說明了為何 GMP 與 GDP 知識要同時掌握。
blocks.en: The brevity of the Qualification definition vs. the detailed GMP definition: The PE 011-1 definition of Qualification is very brief (it mentions only equipment), whereas GMP documents (such as PIC/S Annex 15) define qualification in more detail (the DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ stages). In practice, the GDP concept of qualification should be carried out with the detailed GMP methodology rather than relying only on this short definition. This is also why GMP and GDP knowledge must be mastered together.

blocks.zh: Quality System 的「全部面向」： 定義說 Quality System 是「所有面向的總和」，這意味著沒有任何一個孤立的 SOP 或程序等於 Quality System。它是一個整合性的體系，包含組織架構、職責分工、程序文件、訓練、監控、改善機制等的全部組合。在 GDP 查廠中，稽查員評估的是整個系統，而非個別 SOP。
blocks.en: The "all aspects" of a Quality System: The definition says a Quality System is "the sum of all aspects", which means no single isolated SOP or procedure equals the Quality System. It is an integrated system comprising the organisational structure, responsibilities, procedures, training, monitoring, improvement mechanisms and so on. In a GDP inspection, the inspector evaluates the whole system, not individual SOPs.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 要建立一套符合 GDP 的品質系統。依據「Quality System = 所有面向的總和」，你的 GDP 品質系統至少應包含：
blocks.en: Your CDMO is to set up a GDP-compliant quality system. Based on "Quality System = the sum of all aspects", your GDP quality system should include at least:

blocks.zh: 組織與職責： 品質負責人 (Responsible Person) 的職責定義
blocks.en: Organisation and responsibilities: Definition of the responsibilities of the Responsible Person

blocks.zh: 文件管理： SOP、記錄的控制程序
blocks.en: Document management: Control procedures for SOPs and records

blocks.zh: 倉儲管理： 溫控、FIFO、隔離區管理
blocks.en: Storage management: Temperature control, FIFO, quarantine area management

blocks.zh: 運輸管理： 車輛 qualification、溫度監控、偏差處理
blocks.en: Transport management: Vehicle qualification, temperature monitoring, deviation handling

blocks.zh: 委外管理： 供應商資格評估、合約管理、定期稽核
blocks.en: Outsourced activities management: Supplier qualification assessment, contract management, periodic audits

blocks.zh: 自我查核： 年度計畫、記錄、CAPA 追蹤
blocks.en: Self-inspection: Annual plan, records, CAPA tracking

blocks.zh: 偏差與 CAPA： 發現 → 報告 → 調查 → 改善 → 驗證的完整流程
blocks.en: Deviations and CAPA: The complete flow of detection, reporting, investigation, improvement and verification

blocks.zh: 客訴與假藥回報： 識別、隔離、通報程序
blocks.en: Complaints and falsified medicines reporting: Identification, quarantine and notification procedures

blocks.zh: 你的冷藏倉庫溫控系統已完成 IQ/OQ，但尚未執行 PQ（實際使用條件下的性能確認）。在 GDP 定義下，這個系統算是完成了 Qualification 嗎？
blocks.en: The temperature control system of your cold storage warehouse has completed IQ/OQ but PQ (performance qualification under actual use conditions) has not yet been performed. Under the GDP definition, is the system considered to have completed Qualification?

blocks.zh: GDP 定義中，Quality Risk Management 強調「across the product life cycle（跨產品生命週期）」。對配送環節而言，「生命週期」從哪裡開始、到哪裡結束？
blocks.en: In the GDP definition, Quality Risk Management stresses "across the product life cycle". For the distribution stage, where does the "life cycle" begin and end?

blocks.zh: Group 4: Temperature & Storage Terms — 溫度與儲存術語
blocks.en: Group 4: Temperature & Storage Terms

blocks.zh: Temperature Range Summary（溫度範圍速查）
blocks.en: Temperature Range Summary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：溫度術語的精確定義與合規意涵
blocks.en: Core Concept: Precise Definitions of Temperature Terms and Compliance Implications

blocks.zh: 「In a Refrigerator」= +2 to +8°C（精確邊界）： 這是 GDP 官方定義的冷藏溫度範圍。注意上限是 +8°C，不是 +10°C。在設計倉儲溫控警報時，警報上限設定必須考量這個邊界。一般建議將警報上限設在 7.5°C（預留 0.5°C 緩衝），確保在警報觸發後採取行動前，溫度不超過 8°C 的規格上限。
blocks.en: "In a Refrigerator" = +2 to +8°C (exact boundaries): This is the official GDP definition of the refrigerated temperature range. Note that the upper limit is +8°C, not +10°C. When designing storage temperature alarms, the alarm upper limit must take this boundary into account. A common recommendation is to set the upper alarm limit at 7.5°C (leaving a 0.5°C buffer) so that the temperature does not exceed the 8°C specification limit before action is taken after the alarm is triggered.

blocks.zh: 「Ambient」的特殊定義： Ambient 不是一個固定溫度值，而是「非冷藏藥品所要求的儲存溫度」— 這個溫度由個別藥品的規格書決定。它可能是 15–25°C（等同室溫），或是 15–30°C（更寬鬆的室溫要求）。不能把 Ambient 和 Room Temperature 直接畫等號。
blocks.en: The special definition of "Ambient": Ambient is not a fixed temperature value but "the storage temperature required for non-refrigerated medicinal products", which is determined by the specification of each individual product. It may be 15-25°C (equivalent to room temperature) or 15-30°C (a looser room temperature requirement). Ambient and Room Temperature cannot simply be equated.

blocks.zh: 「Cold or Cool」區間的現實用途： +8 to +15°C 在實務中較少見，但部分植物性製劑或特殊劑型可能有此要求。設計倉庫分區時，如果有這類產品，需要另設一個介於冷藏室和常溫倉之間的「涼倉」。
blocks.en: Practical use of the "Cold or Cool" range: +8 to +15°C is rare in practice, but some herbal preparations or special dosage forms may require it. When designing warehouse zones, if you have such products you need a separate "cool store" between the cold room and the room temperature store.

blocks.zh: 溫度術語就像葡萄酒保存的溫度語言。侍酒師說「這瓶白酒適合在 8–12°C 飲用」，對應 GDP 的「Cold or Cool」區間；而「紅酒室溫 18–22°C」對應 GDP 的「Room Temperature」。如果你把「室溫」理解為台灣夏天的 32°C（沒有空調的室溫），紅酒早就壞了 — GDP 的室溫定義是 15–25°C，台灣倉庫沒有溫控時的「自然室溫」在夏季通常超過這個範圍，所以台灣常溫倉庫必須有空調維持 GDP 定義的「Room Temperature」。
blocks.en: Temperature terms are like the temperature language of wine storage. When a sommelier says "this white wine is best served at 8-12°C", it corresponds to the GDP "Cold or Cool" range, and "red wine at room temperature of 18-22°C" corresponds to the GDP "Room Temperature". If you took "room temperature" to mean a Taiwan summer 32°C (the room temperature without air conditioning), the red wine would be spoiled long ago. The GDP definition of room temperature is 15-25°C, and the "natural room temperature" of an uncontrolled warehouse in Taiwan usually exceeds this range in summer, so Taiwan ambient-temperature warehouses must have air conditioning to maintain the GDP-defined "Room Temperature".

blocks.zh: 台灣夏季倉庫溫控的挑戰： GDP 定義 Room Temperature 為 15–25°C。台灣桃竹苗地區夏季最高氣溫可達 38°C，若倉庫沒有充足的空調系統，室內溫度可能輕易超過 25°C 上限。對於存放「室溫」產品的倉庫，夏季的空調容量計算和溫控驗證是合規關鍵。2024 年之後，TFDA 查廠案例中已有多起因夏季溫控不足導致缺失的記錄。
blocks.en: The challenge of summer warehouse temperature control in Taiwan: GDP defines Room Temperature as 15-25°C. In the Taoyuan-Hsinchu-Miaoli area, summer highs in Taiwan can reach 38°C, and without sufficient air conditioning the indoor temperature can easily exceed the 25°C upper limit. For warehouses storing "room temperature" products, summer air conditioning capacity calculation and temperature control validation are the key to compliance. Since 2024, there have been several recorded TFDA inspection findings caused by inadequate summer temperature control.

blocks.zh: 溫度定義的跨文件一致性： 若你的 SOP 寫「冷藏」，確認它指的是 +2 to +8°C（PE 011-1 定義），而非某人自行認定的「約 4°C 就好」。術語定義的一致性是 GDP 合規的基礎，也是避免誤解（PE 011-1 Chapter 7 所述）的關鍵工具。
blocks.en: Consistency of temperature definitions across documents: If your SOP says "refrigerated", confirm that it means +2 to +8°C (the PE 011-1 definition) and not someone's own idea of "about 4°C is fine". Consistent term definitions are the foundation of GDP compliance and a key tool for avoiding misunderstandings (as described in PE 011-1 Chapter 7).

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求藥品在「ambient conditions」下運輸。如果你的 SOP 將 ambient 設定為 15–25°C，而藥品包裝標示說「Store below 30°C」，兩者有矛盾嗎？你應遵循哪個標準？
blocks.en: Your customer requires medicinal products to be transported under "ambient conditions". If your SOP sets ambient as 15-25°C while the product packaging says "Store below 30°C", is there a conflict? Which standard should you follow?

blocks.zh: 一批「Room Temperature」藥品在冬天（環境溫度 8°C）被放在沒有加溫的貨車廂中運輸 3 小時，貨車廂實際溫度降至 12°C。這是否構成溫度偏差？依據哪個 GDP 定義？
blocks.en: A batch of "Room Temperature" medicinal products is transported for 3 hours in winter (ambient temperature 8°C) in an unheated truck, and the actual temperature inside the truck falls to 12°C. Does this constitute a temperature deviation? Under which GDP definition?

blocks.zh: 一位倉庫員工說：「我們的藥品存放在冷藏室，溫度是 2 到 8 度，跟冰箱的冷涼 8 到 15 度不一樣。」他的理解對嗎？依 PE 011-1 的定義，「冷藏」和「冷涼」有什麼差別？
blocks.en: A warehouse employee says: "Our medicinal products are stored in the refrigerator, at 2 to 8 degrees, which is different from the cold or cool 8 to 15 degrees." Is his understanding correct? Under the PE 011-1 definitions, what is the difference between "refrigerator" and "cold or cool"?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 倉庫有三個溫控區域，需要依 PE 011-1 的溫度定義設定 SCADA 警報參數：
blocks.en: Your CDMO warehouse has three temperature-controlled zones, and the SCADA alarm parameters need to be set according to the PE 011-1 temperature definitions:

blocks.zh: 注意：警報參數應在倉庫 temperature mapping 研究完成後，基於實測的溫度分布數據進行最終設定，而非只依理論值。
blocks.en: Note: The alarm parameters should be finalised after the warehouse temperature mapping study is completed, based on the measured temperature distribution data, and not only on theoretical values.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 供應鏈角色： Contract Giver（委外方）、Contract Acceptor（受託方）、Wholesale Distributor — 每個角色有明確的法規定義，直接決定責任分配
blocks.en: Supply chain roles: Contract Giver, Contract Acceptor and Wholesale Distributor each have a clear regulatory definition that directly determines the allocation of responsibility

blocks.zh: 批發配送的邊界： 包含採購、持有、供應、進口、出口五種活動，但排除直接對公眾供應；Transport 與 Holding 的區分取決於暫存時間是否「合理」
blocks.en: Boundary of wholesale distribution: It covers five activities (procuring, holding, supplying, importing and exporting) but excludes direct supply to the public; the distinction between Transport and Holding depends on whether the storage period is "justified"

blocks.zh: 假藥雙軌定義： EEA 內用三面向定義（身份、來源、歷史），EEA 外用 WHO 的兩要素定義（身份和/或來源的刻意虛假標示）；台灣 CDMO 建議採用 EEA 的更嚴格版本
blocks.en: Dual-track definition of falsified medicinal products: Within the EEA a three-aspect definition (identity, source, history) applies; outside the EEA the WHO two-element definition (deliberate false labelling of identity and/or source) applies; Taiwan CDMOs are advised to adopt the stricter EEA version

blocks.zh: Qualification vs. Validation： Qualification 針對設備，Validation 涵蓋更廣（程序、過程、設備、材料、活動、系統）；實務中兩者需結合 GMP 的 DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ 框架執行
blocks.en: Qualification vs. Validation: Qualification applies to equipment, while Validation is broader (procedure, process, equipment, material, activity, system); in practice both must be carried out together with the GMP DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ framework

blocks.zh: 溫度範圍精確數值： 深凍 <−15°C / 冷藏 +2~+8°C / 冷涼 +8~+15°C / 室溫 +15~+25°C / Ambient = 非冷藏品的個別要求溫度
blocks.en: Exact temperature values: Deep frozen <−15°C / refrigerator +2 to +8°C / cold or cool +8 to +15°C / room temperature +15 to +25°C / Ambient = the individually required temperature for non-refrigerated products

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 應用： 術語定義是 SOP 和合約的語言基礎；在定義警報參數、設計冷鏈系統、起草委外合約時，優先引用 PE 011-1 官方術語，確保跨部門、跨組織的溝通一致性
blocks.en: Application for Taiwan CDMOs: Term definitions are the language foundation of SOPs and contracts; when defining alarm parameters, designing cold chain systems and drafting outsourcing contracts, cite the official PE 011-1 terms first to ensure consistent communication across departments and organisations
